description_ru: Две давние подруги случайно встречаются на вокзале спустя двадцать лет. Одна из них успела стать политиком, и это изрядно усложняет разговор.
text:
Nadia: Tobias? Tobias Merriweather? Good heavens, it is you. You've gone grey.
Tobias: Distinguished, I believe, is the word the party uses. Nadia Kovač, as I live and breathe. Twenty years.
Nadia: Twenty-two. I counted on the train, mostly to avoid reading the paper that carried your photograph.
Tobias: Ah. The photograph. I look rather resolute in it.
Nadia: You look like a man being told his soufflé has collapsed, and being very brave about it.
Tobias: That was the expression the photographer requested. It is called "statesmanlike concern".
Nadia: Of course it is. Tell me, how does a boy who once set fire to the chemistry laboratory end up in charge of the Ministry of Public Works?
Tobias: Strictly speaking, I am only the Under-Secretary. And the laboratory was an accident, which, I may point out, I have never publicly denied.
Nadia: Only because nobody has asked.
Tobias: Quite. That is the beauty of the profession. One simply waits until the questions grow tired.
Nadia: You used to hate that sort of thing. You used to say politicians were just actors who had misplaced their scripts.
Tobias: I said that, did I?
Nadia: Often. Usually at the top of your voice, and usually on the roof of the library.
Tobias: The roof was structurally unsound. I felt the library deserved a witness.
Nadia: The library deserved a fire warden, and received you.
Tobias: Well. I have since discovered that the scripts are not misplaced. They are written by somebody else, at three in the morning, and handed to you in a folder.
Nadia: And you read them.
Tobias: I read them beautifully. I have a gift for sounding as if I mean it. It is, regrettably, the only gift that has never failed.
Nadia: And do you? Mean it, I mean. Even occasionally?
Tobias: Occasionally, by accident, in the middle of a sentence. It is always terribly embarrassing for everyone.
Nadia: That is the saddest thing I have ever heard a man say on Platform Four.
Tobias: It is the only place I can say it. Nobody listens on platforms. They are all too busy looking for the right train.
Nadia: And are you? Looking for the right train?
Tobias: I am looking for the four-fifteen to the capital, which is delayed, which I shall defend in Parliament on Thursday.
Nadia: Then perhaps you can spare half an hour for a coffee, and I will tell you what became of the girl who wrote your essays.
Tobias: You were the girl who wrote my essays! I had quite forgotten.
Nadia: You had not. You merely found it convenient.
Tobias: Guilty. Do I owe you anything?
Nadia: A decent apology, and the price of two coffees. I am now a bridge engineer, as it happens.
Tobias: A bridge engineer. Of course. Of course you are. You always did build the things the rest of us walked across.
Nadia: Don't be gracious. It doesn't suit a man with a motorcade.
Tobias: I shall practise being rude. I have a whole cabinet of colleagues who can give lessons.
Tobias: There is no motorcade. There is a rather tired civil servant and a briefcase.
Nadia: Then come. The cafe has terrible coffee, and a view of the tracks, and nobody has ever recognised anybody in it.
Tobias: That sounds exactly like paradise.
Nadia: Bring your folder. I will correct your grammar.
Tobias: Nadia, I am delighted to report that you are the first person in twenty years to threaten me with anything useful.

focus_sounds.tip_ru: θ: язык между зубами, без голоса; не заменяйте на «с» или «ф»: Thursday, thing.
r: кончик языка поднят и оттянут назад, не касается нёба; не рычите: train, three.
eɪ: дифтонг, от «э» к «и», не обрывайте на «э»: grey, paper, platform.
Связывайте согласный конца слова с гласным начала следующего: once_set, look_at.
